claim_limit: These source-linked cases state the distinctions this increment must preserve. They are not executed fresh-actor trials, an independent oracle, acceptance judgments or whole-candidate qualification.

cases.trigger: A request labelled bug asks for behavior the current requirement does not define.
cases.expected: Intake determines the actual affected relation and lawful re-entry. The label does not authorize a realization-only repair or supply missing requirement meaning.

cases.trigger: Two frames repeat the same diagnosis, and neither distinguishes a code defect from a failed external assumption.
cases.expected: Renaming the analysis supplies no additional evidence. The cause remains unresolved, and the diagnosis grants no mutation.

cases.trigger: A person executes a deterministic procedure in a mixed tenant binding; requirements live outside the default requirements directory and no graph profile is adopted.
cases.expected: Executor identity alone does not make this human adjudication. The Product binding locates requirements, and conformance follows the requirement-to-operation relation. Graph/runtime duties arise only through adoption.

cases.trigger: An authorized action ends this run, has no surviving independent state, and no existing exact ticket or sprint covers it.
cases.expected: The smallest-carrier policy permits the intake-drafted run contract with actual admission and its durable result surface. It does not require a new durable ticket or Executive solely for ceremony.

cases.trigger: An obligation must survive the run but the actor lacks ticket-state authority.
cases.expected: The obligation remains on the contract's authorized durable result surface or already-authorized enclosing carrier, closure is withheld on ticket-state authority, and the actor returns the re-entry. A need for durability does not grant ticket creation.

cases.trigger: A ticket says active/admitted but supplies no actual admission evidence or current upstream grant.
cases.expected: Carrier state cannot self-certify the exact contract, renew a growth basis or establish that execution occurred. The refusal retains the deciding reason and any independently known effects.

cases.trigger: A lawful owner rejection is recorded and its decision result is satisfied, while work closure requires acceptance of that exact subject.
cases.expected: The decision result retains its truth but does not satisfy the separate acceptance predicate. A completed review likewise supplies no absent closure condition. A Writer may record bounded completion where independent review and reserved acceptance do not apply.

cases.trigger: One tenant passes a shared requirement while a peer has an unresolved blocker; a board displays a single green status.
cases.expected: Each tenant's proof and lifecycle remain local. The board cannot hide the peer blocker or become a competing state authority.

cases.trigger: A sprint stops after all iterations complete but retains unpaid applicable proof debt.
cases.expected: Stopping the batch does not satisfy its closure conjunction. The existing escrow and close classifications govern debt and durable follow-up; triage and law-changing re-entry remain applicable.

cases.trigger: A publication command fails after dispatch; the remote state has not been observed.
cases.expected: Publication remains unresolved at the actual remote-effect boundary. A local failure is not proof of no effect, and retry does not authorize moving an immutable published cut.

cases.trigger: Source checks pass, an external-service qualification is skipped, and the release claims installed behavior using that service.
cases.expected: The observed source predicate can remain satisfied while the dependent installed capability remains unestablished. Qualification requires appropriate evidence or lawful narrowing before acceptance.

cases.trigger: The latest selector advances, or the target/definition drifts after a consumer accepts an adoption plan.
cases.expected: Selector movement does not change the consumer basis. Drift invalidates the plan acceptance. Explicit retention of an older immutable cut remains lawful through the exact-basis route.

cases.trigger: An accepted or reviewed RC is edited, or a cohort has matching version labels but a stale derived member.
cases.expected: The old assessment stays on its old cut. Further qualifying-byte changes need a higher RC. Matching labels do not establish source congruence or transfer acceptance among cohort Products.

cases.trigger: A successor implements an old claim with different code, or proposes removing it because its predecessor patch is absent.
cases.expected: Different realization can conserve meaning on evidence; patch absence alone proves neither loss nor removal authority. Changed meaning/removal and its semantic assessment remain separate owner-bound relations.

cases.trigger: Two authorities use the same readable token, a regex matches a family heading, or a runtime default conflicts with published domain grammar.
cases.expected: Scoped kind/value interpretation distinguishes the subjects. Pattern matching supplies only its syntax claim. Runtime transport/defaults do not create domain meaning or displace a lawful published override.

cases.trigger: A stable identity carries a revoked grant, or a proxy records a ruling beyond its original mandate.
cases.expected: Stable identity cannot keep stale evidence or revoked authority current. Recording and transport cannot widen authority; actor, grantor and required independence remain distinct.

cases.trigger: A successor exactly reconstructs historical manifest/member bytes, and the author claims that this proves semantic derivation or installs the predecessor as governing law.
cases.expected: The exact content/reference predicates can pass while derivation, historical acceptance, successor authority and publication remain separate. The evidence carrier does not make the historical predecessor operative.

cases.trigger: An ordinary consumer imports a family table whose rows name many other consumers.
cases.expected: Consumer inventories remain review provenance; they do not become universal required-acquisition edges. Evaluate the selected row's premises and applicability while preserving genuinely required operation dependencies.
cases.integration_check_required: Re-run the existing I3 conditional/provenance acquisition controls on the integrated account and generated interpretation. This source Writer has not regenerated them.
